What was wrong or missed:
- Predicted Aurora kinase inhibitors over DNA damage despite atlas favoring DNA damage 4/10 over Aurora 3/10 (e5)
- Overweighted rare binucleates at 30uM (e4) while discounting negative frac_multinucleate_proxy and negative frac_mitotic_like dose response (e13) that contradicted failed cytokinesis/mitotic arrest
- Misinterpreted single smooth enlarged nuclei with high integrated DNA (e14) at 3uM as Aurora polyploidy instead of etoposide topoisomerase II poison G2 arrest, without a DNA-damage marker acquisition

Proposed next experiment: Etoposide dose series with gammaH2AX immunofluorescence plus DNA-content flow cytometry with pHH3-S10 and a cell-free topoisomerase II decatenation assay to confirm DNA-damage G2 arrest versus Aurora-like failed cytokinesis.
